author: TED
description:
The check lands on the table. Everyone freezes.
Do you let your friend pay and call it a gift? Insist on covering it? Or promise to get the next one?
Corner Piece host Sabrina puts Taha, Melissa and the audience to the test, and it turns out “what do we owe each other?” is a much harder question than it sounds.
Visit https://link.mgln.ai/42sA1T to hear how it plays out.
title: Would you let your friend pay for dinner? #TEDTalks

author: TED
description:
There's a whole world of food growing right outside our doors — in our backyards, on sidewalks, in the parks we walk through every day — and most of us pass by it without a second glance. Alexis Nikole Nelson wants to change that. A self-described "ethnobotany nerd," she’s spent years teaching people how to forage the wild food hiding in plain sight. She explores how paying closer attention to what’s already around us can reconnect us to the land, our communities and each other.
